summary: Suffolk County DA and county judge; John's 5th cousin 6x removed; his heirs held the blunderbuss 'Old Crib' in 1898.
bio: Path: Bull Smith → Richard 2d → Sarah (m. Nathaniel Woodhull) → Gen. Nathaniel Woodhull → Elizabeth (m. Henry Nicoll) → Eliza Willett Nicoll (m. Richard Smith) → J. Lawrence. His Smith surname also comes through his father's own Smithtown line.
